returns.title: Return and Refund Policy
returns.description: We want every {storeName} order to feel clear after checkout. This page explains when items can be returned, how refund reviews work, and what happens after an approved return reaches us.

summaryItems.text: Eligible delivered items can be returned after review.
Refunds are issued after approval and inspection.
Final sale, digital, and unsafe-to-resell items may be excluded.

returns.howItWorksDescription: Returns and refunds are separate steps. A return request handles eligibility, shipment, and inspection. A refund sends or records the money after the return is approved.

steps.title: Open your order
steps.description: Go to your account order history or track your order using the order number and checkout contact details.

steps.title: Choose eligible items
steps.description: Select the item quantity you want to return and share the reason, notes, and photos when needed.

steps.title: Wait for review
steps.description: Our team, and the vendor when applicable, reviews the request against the return window and item condition.

steps.title: Send the item back
steps.description: After approval, follow the return instructions. Keep your carrier receipt until the return is closed.

steps.title: Inspection and refund
steps.description: Once received and inspected, eligible refunds are issued to the original payment method or recorded manually.

eligibleItems.text: Delivered physical products requested within 30 days of delivery.
Items in unused, clean, and resaleable condition unless they arrived damaged or defective.
Items with original packaging, tags, accessories, and included documents.
Partial quantities from an order, as long as they have not already been returned or refunded.

excludedItems.text: Digital goods, services, downloadable products, and gift cards.
Final sale, clearance, customized, or personalized products.
Perishable, hygiene-sensitive, intimate, or opened sealed goods when not defective.
Items damaged by misuse, missing parts, or returned outside the approved window.

returns.refundRulesDescription: Refunds are capped at the remaining refundable order balance. Shipping, taxes, discounts, and fees may be adjusted based on the approved items and the condition received.

refundRules.title: Original payment method
refundRules.description: Card, PayPal, Razorpay, and Paystack refunds are sent back through the original payment provider when possible.

refundRules.title: Partial refunds
refundRules.description: If only part of an order is returned, the refund may include the item amount, eligible tax, and selected fees.

refundRules.title: Manual refunds
refundRules.description: COD, cash, POS, and manual payments may be handled outside the payment gateway and recorded by the store team.

refundRules.title: Inventory review
refundRules.description: Refunds and inventory are separate decisions. Items are restocked only after inspection confirms they can be resold.

returns.statusesDescription: These are the typical states you may see as the return moves from request review to refund completion.

statuses.label: Requested
statuses.description: Your return request has been submitted for review.

statuses.label: Approved
statuses.description: The return is accepted and return instructions are provided.

statuses.label: In transit
statuses.description: The returned item is on its way back to the store or vendor.

statuses.label: Received
statuses.description: The returned item has arrived and is waiting for inspection.

statuses.label: Refund pending
statuses.description: The approved refund is being prepared or sent to the payment provider.

statuses.label: Refunded
statuses.description: The refund has been issued or manually recorded.

returns.beforeReturnDescription: Please wait for approval and return instructions. Items sent back without approval can take longer to identify and may not qualify for refund processing.
returns.ctaDescription: Start from your order history if you have an account. If you checked out without signing in, use the tracking page with your order number and checkout email or phone.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Find quick answers to common questions about shopping, shipping, and returns.

items.question: How long does shipping take?
items.answer: Standard shipping usually takes 3-7 business days depending on your location.

items.question: What is your return policy?
items.answer: You can return eligible items within 30 days of delivery. Items must be unused and in original packaging.

items.question: How can I track my order?
items.answer: Once your order ships, you will receive a tracking link by email and in your account order history.

about.storyBody:
{storeName} started with a simple observation: good products were sitting in small workshops with no way to reach anyone beyond their own street.

So we built the thing those sellers actually needed: a shared storefront where each of them keeps their own name, their own prices and their own customers, while the hard parts of selling online are handled once, for everyone.

Every seller on {storeName} runs their own shop. We keep the lights on.
